candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting!
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career?
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Civil Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry.
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Civil Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced civil engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland.
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.
Why you’ll love working here
Start building your career
Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical civil drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters.
Work on real projects
Go beyond the classroom and see how civil engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery.
Learn from experienced people
Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow.
Be part of a great team
Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do.
Work in Fortitude Valley
Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity 
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Assist with preparing civil drawings, plans and project documentation.
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings.
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes.
- Develop your understanding of how civil engineering projects are designed and delivered.
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements.
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members.
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.
About you:
You could be a great fit if you are:
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver or currently studying Civil Drafting at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in civil drafting, design and engineering.
- Curious and keen to learn new skills.
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work.
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback.
- Reliable, organized and willing to have a go at new challenges.
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team.
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident.
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career.
What’s in it for you?
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development.
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution.
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs.
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program.
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy.
About STP Consultants 
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. 
Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take.
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes.
Ready to get started?  
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you.
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter.
In your cover letter, tell us:
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in civil drafting.  2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants.
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

At the heart of our business are our greatest assets, our people, our culture and our core values of honesty, openness and fairness.

 If you are looking to gain real-world engineering experience, work alongside experienced professionals and build a long-term career in civil construction, we would love to hear from you.   Apply now or contact Suzi Dimech at suzid@quickway.com.au for further information.

- Assisting with the design and engineering of retaining walls
- Assisting with geotechnical assessments and engineering calculations
- Using PLAXIS for geotechnical modelling and analysis
- Assisting with stability analysis and retaining wall design
- Reviewing engineering drawings, plans and project specifications

- Assisting with design changes and technical queries during construction
- Preparing and maintaining engineering and construction documentation
- Assisting with ITPs, QA/QC documentation and project records
- Assisting with quantities, material take-offs and progress claims
- Checking construction works against approved drawings and specifications
- Liaising with project managers, supervisors, subcontractors, consultants and suppliers
- Identifying engineering and construction issues and assisting with practical solutions
- Assisting with technical documentation, reports and project correspondence
- Maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality and compliance

The ideal candidate will have:
- A Civil Engineering degree or relevant qualification
- 0–3 years' experience in civil or structural construction/engineering
- A strong interest in retaining wall design and geotechnical engineering
- PLAXIS experience and an understanding of geotechnical modelling
- Knowledge of retaining wall design principles and stability analysis
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication and organisational skills
- A practical understanding of construction methodologies

- Geotechnical engineering

- Slope and global stability analysis

One month you're detailing a low-to-medium rise residential tower, the next it's an industrial park, a fire station or a mine-site steel frame.
We're a small, close-knit structural engineering consultancy based in North Lakes, and we're after a structural draftsperson who wants genuine variety and real ownership of their work.
What you'll draft
- Multi-residential towers – low to medium rise apartment buildings and townhouse developments, from preliminary layouts through to full construction documentation
- Industrial and commercial – warehouses, industrial parks and steel-framed buildings, with the connection detailing that goes with them
- Community and civic buildings – fire stations, PCYCs, indoor sports centres and education facilities
- Retail, mixed-use and hospitality – projects where structure, services and architecture all have to work together
- Mining and resources – steel frames, skids and support structures for industrial clients
- Residential – new homes, house raises, extensions, decks and pools: quick-turnaround jobs that keep the week moving
You'll work in Revit across the full project – general notes, footing and framing plans, sections and details – and your name goes on the drawing sets.
What you'll need
- 2+ years hands-on Revit experience
- The confidence to work autonomously and own your deadlines
- Queensland based, able to be in our North Lakes office around 2 days a week
- Australian citizenship or permanent residents only
Full-time or part-time – your call
We're open to either. Choose a full-time role, or tell us the part-time hours that suit you, whether that's 3 or 4 days a week or shorter days around school pick-ups or study. We'll work the role around what you need. Part-time hours are pro-rata on the same salary range, and the hybrid setup still applies: part of your week in the North Lakes office, the rest at home or the office, your choice.
What we offer
- Real hybrid flexibility – typically 2 days a week in the North Lakes office working alongside the team. The rest of the week is yours: work from home or come into the office, whatever suits you.
- A proper setup in both places – you'll get a laptop that moves with you, plus a docking station set up at your home and one at the office. Just plug in and pick up where you left off, wherever you're working that day. Current Revit licences included.
- Variety you won't get at a big firm – residential, commercial, industrial, civic and mining work, often in the same month
- Ownership – you'll run drawing sets from start to issue, not just pick up redlines on someone else's model
- Career growth – room to take on more responsibility as the practice grows, with training and CPD support
- Northside location – our North Lakes office means no CBD commute
- A team that knows each other – small crew, regular catch-ups and annual team events, including our EOFY dinner
To apply, send your CV and a few sample drawing sheets (PDF is fine) to admin@skyhookengineering.com.au.

About working with us:

About the City:
The City of Swan, located north east of Perth, is the largest local government by land size in the Perth metropolitan area, and has one of the fastest growing populations. 
The City covers an area of 1,042 square kilometres, equivalent to almost 20 per cent of the Perth metropolitan area. A beautifully diverse expanse of land, the City is rich in natural assets, including the iconic Swan River and internationally renowned Swan Valley viticulture region established in 1829. Our location, services and facilities make the City an attractive place to live. The population across our 42 suburbs stands at 168,334 in 2023, but is set to reach 300,000 by 2050. 
The Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation have been the traditional custodians of the land for more than 40,000 years. The Derbal Yerrigan (Swan River) holds enormous cultural significance for the Noongar people. The City is also rich in European history, and our community is a melting pot of multiculturalism, with one in three people being born overseas and one in five speaking a language other than English at home. Our ideal location, significant history, diverse community and strong economy ensures a positive future for the City of Swan, full of opportunity.
Our purpose at the City is to improve the quality of life for all of the people who live in, work in and visit the City of Swan by delivering our vision of ‘one city, diverse people, culture and places’ through shared values of respect, excellence, accountability and leadership. 
At the City of Swan we are committed to recruiting and retaining the right people and creating a great place to work.  We offer our employees real careers, real impact, and real rewards. 
We welcome everyone exactly as they are. We welcome people with diverse skills, experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds and encourage applications from Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander peoples, people who identify as LGBTIQA+, people with disabilities, people with a culturally and linguistically diverse background, and people of all ages.

For queries regarding the application process, please contact our friendly People Services team on (08) 9267 9014.

ABI Civil Contracting NSW is a progressive Australian civil contractor delivering major infrastructure projects across NSW and ACT.
Our projects span transport infrastructure, bridges, utilities, renewable energy, high voltage substations, data centres, defence and major commercial developments.

- Assist in the preparation of tender submissions and pricing schedules.
- Support the development of construction methodologies and procurement strategies.
- Identify project risks and opportunities.
- Participate in tender reviews and project handovers.
- Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and subcontractors.
What you’ll bring
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Minimum 3 years' estimating experience within the Australian civil construction industry.
- Experience preparing or assisting in the preparation of civil infrastructure tenders.
- Strong quantity take-off and analytical skills.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel capability.
- The ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- A proactive and team-oriented approach.
- A current NSW Driver Licence.
What We Offer

- Opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure projects.
- Career progression within a growing civil contractor.
- Supportive leadership team and professional working environment.

·         Current driver's licence and reliable transport

candidates.content_text:
Work in CAD every day on some of the most capable pipe profiling equipment in the country.
Waypoint  is partnering with Surepipe to appoint a CAD Draftsperson / Estimator supporting the growth of their steel pipe processing and profiling capability.
Surepipe is a privately owned steel pipe supply and processing business working exclusively in carbon steel, servicing the mining, drilling and minerals, structural, pressure vessel and general industrial markets across Australia and the Pacific.
Their point of difference is the profiling. The equipment is European-built and among the most capable of its type in the country, the same class of machine used to profile structural pipework for major stadium projects overseas. It allows Surepipe to add real value to a length of pipe before it reaches a customer's workshop, delivering ready-to-weld product and a genuine efficiency gain for fabricators.
The role
You'll be working in CAD daily. Checking and interpreting customer drawings, making modifications, adding weld preparation detail, and getting drawings out to the profiler so the operators can keep running.
You'll also translate customer concepts and sketches into CAD models, taking an idea through to something that can be priced and cut. Research and development work sits here too, turning concept sketches into models for new products and accessories.
Alongside the CAD, you'll prepare estimates from customer drawings and specifications, with enough detail that the customer service team can run with them. Speed matters, and turning enquiries around the same or next business day is a real competitive advantage.
You'll manage scheduling across the processing function, balancing customer expectations against machine capacity, and provide technical support to the internal sales team and the Business Development Managers on tenders.
Who will you be working with?
You'll report to the manager who leads the processing function, who has a fabrication and engineering background and will back you while you find your feet.
You'll sit alongside a minerals and resources team leader, internal sales team members, Business Development Managers, and the operations team.
What is on offer
 - Competitive base salary plus super
 - Quarterly bonus available after probation. It applies to every team member and is based purely on revenue and gross profit
 - Laptop and CAD workstation provided
 - Quarterly check-ins and a full annual review. The business actively supports further study
 - Genuine progression as the processing capability grows, either toward leading a processing department or toward estimating and project management
 - Varied work, from small fabrication jobs through to multi-million dollar packages, including major infrastructure and public art works across Australia and into the Pacific regions
What Surepipe is looking for
 - Operational CAD capability. You'll be working in drawings every day, building and modifying models rather than just reading them. Surepipe currently uses Fusion 360 and ProCAM but isn't locked into a platform
 - Some exposure to estimating or quoting. You don't need years of it, but you should be comfortable taking a set of drawings and working toward a number
 - A TAFE diploma or similar two-year qualification in engineering or drafting. Degree-qualified candidates are welcome but it's not required
 - Exposure to CAM or machine programming is an advantage
 - An understanding of Australian Standards for steel is an advantage, though it can be taught
 - Genuinely detail-oriented, and disciplined enough to check rather than assume
 - Outgoing, communicative and collaborative. This role sits in the middle of the business and you'll be working closely with the team every day
 - Strong written and spoken English
 Early-career candidates are genuinely encouraged to apply. If you've got the CAD capability and some quoting exposure, Surepipe will back you to grow into the rest. The business actively supports further study, and candidates still completing a qualification will be considered.
Backgrounds of interest include steel processing and distribution, laser cutting and profiling, structural steel fabrication, and pipe or tube supply.
Location and working arrangements
Fully site based in Brendale, and you'll spend time in the workshop and on the machine to stay familiar with the capability.
Interested?
Apply with your CV, or contact Sam O'Brien at sam@waypointconsulting.com.au for a confidential conversation.

candidates.content_text:
We are seeking a JUNIOR ARCHITECTURAL DRAFTSPERSON to join our expanding Drafting team. The role is part of a supportive, collaborative environment where your expertise will directly contribute to delivering quality outcomes for our clients both internally and externally.
Our Drafting team is responsible for the production of detailed and professional working drawings, as well as undertaking Prestart variations, and all other related drafting work. The Drafting team is also involved in liaising with supervisors, administration staff and local authorities.
The key responsibilities are:
- Prestart/General variations and Sitings
- Production of working drawings using ArchiCAD
- Help ensure plans align with the NCC, R-Codes and relevant Australian Standards
- Liaise with external engineers and certifiers to ensure compliance, including shires and developers.
- Continue to develop your drafting skills and industry knowledge
The successful applicant should possess the following:
- Ability to work on a full-time basis (Monday – Friday)
- A qualification of Certificate IV in Residential Building Drafting.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Strong ability to work and contribute in a team environment.
- Strong organisational skills, with an ability to meet strict project deadlines.
- Proficiency in ArchiCAD software is essential.
- Knowledge of the Perth construction industry and building technique is highly regarded but not essential, as on-the-job training will be provided.
- A positive attitude, strong work-ethic and the ability to self-motivate.
What We Offer
- Permanent full-time position
- Flexible working hours
- Free on-site parking
- Competitive salary
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
Where You'll Be Working
This role is based at our Head Office in Osborne Park. You'll be joining a passionate and innovative team that values both personal growth and professional excellence.

candidates.abstract: Support the planning, design and delivery of the Story Bridge Renewal Program by providing expertise, project coordination and technical leadership
candidates.content_text:
Personnel Area: Infrastructure Services Group
Branch: Project Management
Salary Range: This position attracts a competitive remuneration and benefits package dependent on the skills and experience of the successful candidate
Work type: Temporary Full-time 
Duration: Up to 36 months (Extension/s thereafter but not guaranteed). 
Location: Brisbane Square 
Number of Vacancies: 2
Our Business
Infrastructure Services Group (ISG) brings together Council's asset management, infrastructure planning, design, project management, construction, services, maintenance and transport operations activities.​
Our Branch 
Project Management Branch (PMB) delivers project management, assurance and commercial services for service owners across Council. We work closely with asset owners to turn approved investments into delivered infrastructure and services, while improving how projects are planned, governed and tracked across the full lifecycle.
Story Bridge Renewal Program
Brisbane City Council is extending the life of the Story Bridge for another 100 years. This incredible role will join the Story Bridge Renewal Program, a dedicated team that is leading the restoration of Brisbane’s iconic Story Bridge.
The Role
Support the planning, procurement, design and delivery of the Story Bridge Renewal Program (SBRP) by providing engineering expertise, project coordination and technical leadership across assigned work packages. Working as part of an integrated project team, you will collaborate with consultants, contractors and stakeholders to manage project interfaces, resolve complex technical challenges and help deliver safe, high-quality outcomes that support the successful renewal of one of Brisbane's most iconic assets. Success in this role will require the ability to operate effectively within a complex and dynamic major infrastructure program, navigating evolving priorities, emerging risks, multiple stakeholder interfaces and an evolving organisational environment while maintaining focus on successful delivery outcomes.
To be successful you will have: 
- demonstrated experience leading the planning and delivery of complex infrastructure projects or programs to achieve scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety and stakeholder outcomes.
- demonstrated ability to apply engineering expertise and project management capability to support the planning, procurement, design and delivery of complex infrastructure projects.
- demonstrated experience working within multidisciplinary project environments and coordinating activities across consultants, contractors, technical specialists and stakeholders.
- demonstrated experience identifying, managing and resolving project risks, issues, interfaces and dependencies associated with the delivery of complex projects.
- demonstrated ability to work effectively within integrated project teams and build productive relationships to achieve project outcomes.
- demonstrated high level written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of project documentation, reports, briefings and correspondence.
- demonstrated high level communication, consultation and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.
A Bachelor’s degree qualification in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management or a related discipline is a mandatory requirement for this role.
A valid Criminal History Check is a mandatory requirement for this role.

If our values resonate with you, please submit an application for the position. candidates.content_text:
Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
At Downer Energy & Utilities, we are looking for motivated and ambitious Graduate Engineers to join our team and contribute to delivering critical infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand.
As a Graduate Engineer, you will participate in a structured graduate program, with the possibility of rotating across various business functions and project environments. You will gain valuable hands on experience supporting operational, financial, programming and administrative activities while working alongside experienced industry professionals.
This role offers the opportunity to build your technical capability, develop commercial awareness and strengthen stakeholder engagement skills while contributing to projects that power and connect communities. Flexibility and mobility are essential, as project based work may require travel and relocation throughout Australia and/ or New Zealand. 
What We're Looking For
- Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering, completed in 2025 or due for completion by the end of 2026
- Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency
- Hold current driver's licence and availability to commence in February 2027
- A willingness to learn, an open mindset and a desire to build your professional career from the ground up
- Strong communication and relationship building skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn from experienced professionals
- A proactive, self motivated attitude with a commitment to ongoing development
What We Offer
At Downer, we are committed to developing our people and providing meaningful career opportunities.
You will benefit from:
- Exposure to major infrastructure and utilities projects across Australia
- Mentoring and support from experienced industry professionals
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Strong focus on safety, sustainability and innovation
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Competitive remuneration and employee benefits
- Opportunities for long term career growth within a leading infrastructure services provider 
About Energy & Utilities
Downer Energy & Utilities delivers end to end engineering, construction, maintenance and asset management services to customers across power, gas, water, telecommunications and renewable energy sectors. Our people work on some of Australia's most significant infrastructure projects, helping to build sustainable communities and support the nation's future energy needs.
At Downer, our success is driven by our people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, culturally diverse individuals and people with disabilities.
How to Apply
To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your application online including your resume and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about building a career in the utilities and infrastructure sector and are committed to delivering safe and sustainable outcomes for our customers and communities.
Please note: Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes, fees or costs from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Downer or its employees will become the property of Downer and Downer will not be liable for any associated fees.

With over a century of heritage in Australia, BESIX Watpac is a builder deeply ingrained in the local construction landscape. We’re building what matters, with an exciting portfolio of projects across all sectors – from stadiums and venues to complex industrial facilities, hospitals and secure infrastructure, including defence. Our footprint spans Australia and New Zealand, where we continue to deliver projects that leave a lasting legacy in the communities they serve. Our people are the beating heart of what we do, and the passion they bring each day drives our success, to build the best together.

BESIX Watpac is seeking a Graduate Engineer to join our Construction SA division on a part-time basis, working through to our graduate program which will allow you to see all facets of the construction industry including Engineering, Design, Estimating and Safety this is a fantastic opportunity for a university student to secure a role with a Top Tier building contractor.
You will take part of our BESIX Watpac Graduate and Early Career Development Program. This program aims to develop and grow our future leaders. This two-year program builds technical knowledge within the context of an on-the-job environment and provides opportunities to develop professional business and leadership skills. BESIX Watpac Graduates & Cadets gain exposure to various areas of project delivery, and come together for learning workshops, networking, and social events.
This role will be responsible for:
- Assist in preparing cost plans and tenders by reviewing project requirements, compiling tender documentation, and coordinating proposed tender lists.
- Support quality assurance and safety management processes by monitoring compliance with project standards, documenting non-conformances, and assisting with the implementation of corrective actions.
- Contribute to estimating and project controls activities through quantity take-offs, cost analysis, subcontractor scope reviews, procurement support, and the preparation of tender submissions and budget forecasts.
- Assist with general site duties, office and administration as required.
Qualifications
The incumbent in this role will require:
- Currently studying a university-level degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook and ability and willingness to learn new software packages as required.
- Proven high level of professionalism and work ethic.
- Proven track record and ongoing focus on timeliness, accuracy and punctuality.
Additional Information
Along with a competitive remuneration package and long-term career development opportunities, our employees enjoy access to the following benefits:
- Wellbeing Days - three additional leave days per year.
- Awards and Recognition Program, rewarding employees who bring our values to life.
- Access to a wellbeing program including annual skin checks and flu vaccinations.
- Instant access to Perkbox, giving you a wide variety of perks and benefits, plus curated wellbeing tools to look after your physical and mental health.
- Social events and Family Days.
At BESIX Watpac, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone is valued, supported and respected. By embracing all ages, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, education and appearance, our people feel safe, empowered, and motivated to be their best.  If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick all the boxes, we encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills and believe you would be a great fit with BESIX Watpac.
Join our talented and passionate team delivering once-in-a-generation projects.
BESIX Watpac acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land on which we live and work, and pay respect to the Elders past, present and emerging.

- Strong work ethic and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- Commitment to workplace health and safety standards.
- Good communication skills and reliability.

- Work in a supportive team environment.
- Diverse and hands-on role with meaningful impact.

We are looking for experienced Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) Project Engineers and Contractor's Quality Representatives (CQR) to join our high calibre BMD Urban team, working with senior members of the project team to achieve optimum production and cost outcomes in the Townsville Region. Drawing on your learnings from a successful engineering career, you will be self-motivated to mentor Site Engineers and Graduates to achieve innovative solutions to complex challenges. You will provide onsite engineering services and technical support to fearlessly strive towards safety, environmental, specification, design and contractual requirements. 
Projects include;
- Land development - Residential and Industrial Sub-divisions
- Water / Sewer upgrades
- Road infrastructure for local councils and Townsville City Council (TCCS), and TMR.
- Defence contracts
The successful candidate will be a self-starter with:
- a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or appropriate CQR qualifications in surveying, quality management or similar qualifications
- high level verbal and written communication skills
- minimum four years’ experience in the civil construction industry
- excellent attitude towards health, safety, environmental and quality outcomes, embedding this commitment in everything you do
- motivation to achieve value-for-money results
- previous experience with major tier one or two contractors undertaking similar work (ideally TMR work).
For further details, head to www.bmd.com.au.
Due to the high volume of applications and enquiries, we are only able to respond to shortlisted candidates.
No agency submissions will be accepted.

candidates.content_text:
Building Cadet, Commercial Construction
About Echo Projects Co
Echo Projects Co is a commercial builder based in Windsor, Brisbane. We deliver commercial spaces across hospitality, retail, workplace, medical and education in South-East Queensland, from new builds to landlord upgrades and refurbishments. We're a growing business with a tight, experienced team and a strong pipeline of work. We pride ourselves on clear communication with clients, subcontractors and each other, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.
About the role
This is a genuine cadet role. You'll be one of a small group of cadets rotating through the three parts of our business: projects, site and estimating. Each rotation gives you real responsibility on live commercial projects, working alongside our project managers, site managers and estimator. By the end, you'll understand how a construction business runs from first enquiry through to handover, and you'll know where you want to take your career.
What you'll do
Projects
- Support contract administration, including progress claims, variations and correspondence
- Prepare subcontracts and scopes of works
- Run document control across live projects
- Prepare project reports
Site
- Support the site team with administration, records and coordination
- Communicate with subcontractors and suppliers
- Learn how jobs are set out, sequenced and handed over
Estimating
- Assist with tender preparation, quantities and pricing
- Help put together subcontractor quotes and tender submissions
About you
- Currently enrolled in a construction management or related degree at university (this is a requirement)
- Clear written and verbal communication; you follow things up without being chased
- Organised, reliable and keen to learn every part of the business
- Current driver's licence and reliable transport
- Around a year in construction (site, a builder's office or a trade) would be great, but it's not essential. If you're keen to learn and willing to work, we want to hear from you.
What we offer
- Flexibility around uni classes and exams
- A clear path into project management, site management or estimating
- Work directly with experienced people, not buried in a back office
- Learn alongside other cadets in a structured program
- Laptop, monthly phone allowance, uniform, boots and PPE supplied
- First aid and CPR training
- Inner city office in Windsor
How to apply
Apply with your resume and a short cover letter telling us why you want to build a career in commercial construction, and which of projects, site or estimating interests you most.
